title: kv-cache: adaptive spillover + auto-compaction heuristics and paging threshold tuning
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: reduce memory fragmentation and unexpected OOM/latency spikes caused by KV cache spillover during heterogeneous sequence-length workloads. This PR introduces an adaptive auto-compaction heuristic, tuned paging thresholds, and safer spillover admission to improve tail latency and reduce cross-request interference. This PR introduces an adaptive auto-compaction heuristic, tuned paging thresholds, and safer spillover admission to improve tail latency and reduce cross-request interference. The description below uses a checklist style but is a single continuous string. - Implement an adaptive compaction pass that runs opportunistically when fragmentation ratio > 0.35 and recent spill events exceed a threshold. The compaction is incremental and bounded by a budget (ms per tick) to avoid CPU spikes. - Add a soft paging threshold that prefers evicting low-reuse prefixes before paging entire KV slabs, reducing writeback pressure and PCIe transfers. - Introduce spillover admission control: requests that would trigger heavy spill/paging are routed to a best-effort queue and can fallback to a smaller model variant when available. This is configurable per-deployment. - Expose runtime flags and operator-friendly tuning knobs (fragmentation_ratio_target, compaction_budget_ms, paging_soft_threshold_pct). - Add telemetry: kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.compaction_runs, kv.spill_events, kv.paging_bytes, kv.eviction_type_counts. Dashboards updated in docs. - Add unit and integration tests that simulate fragmentation and validate no regression in steady-state throughput. Add a canary run with dedicated workloads in perf lab. Checklist: - [x] Implementation in src/runtime/kv_cache.* - [x] Tests added under tests/kv_cache/* - [x] Docs and operator notes at docs/ops/kv-cache.md - [x] Benchmarks run (see CI notes) - [x] Rollout plan included in description Rollout and safety: default values are conservative and this feature is off by default for on-prem Private installs. Hosted will enable behind a staged rollout with canary on 5% of traffic and a metric-based rollback. We added a runtime boolean (kv.adaptive_compaction.enabled) so operators can opt out. Performance: lab benchmarks show median decode latency improvement of ~1.8% for heterogeneous seq-len workloads and a 3x reduction in spill events on a mixed Llama-2-like model profile in our perf-canary setup. Memory overhead for compaction metadata is ~0.6% of KV memory. Related: builds on prior spillover and defrag work (see ENG-1011, PRs in the kv-cache series). Addresses customer SUP-783 report about OOMs during long chat histories.

release_notes: Adaptive KV cache compaction and spillover controls: reduces fragmentation and spill events, adds operator tuning knobs and telemetry. Default off for Private; staged rollout for Hosted.
notes_for_ops: Flags: kv.adaptive_compaction.enabled=false by default; recommended fragmentation_ratio_target=0.35, compaction_budget_ms=5, paging_soft_threshold_pct=70. Monitor kv.fragmentation_ratio and kv.spill_events before enabling.
rollback_plan: Feature gated boolean and can be disabled via runtime flag. Canary rollout with auto rollback on >10% increase in p95 latency or >2x spill_events within 30m.
testing: Unit tests added for compaction correctness. Integration simulator validates spill admission and paging behavior. Perf canary run included in CI perf job.
